name: S30 Pro Max Smart Watch with 7 Straps. Series 10 Infinity Screen Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch
description:
S30 Pro Max Smart Watch – Series 10 Infinity Screen (with 7 Straps)

Model: S30 Pro Max
Dial Size: 49mm
Strap Material: Silica Gel (7 straps included)
Display: 2.09" LCD (320 × 385) Full Touch Screen
Colors Available: Black, Orange, Silver
Battery Capacity: 220mAh
Battery Backup: 2–5 Days
Charging Mode: Wireless Charging
Water Resistance: IP65 (splash-proof, not suitable for immersion)
Body Material: Zinc Alloy

Key Features:
1. Calling Function

Bluetooth Calling

Dial Pad

Common Contact List

Call Log & Caller ID

Answer / Reject Calls

2. Motion Monitoring

Pedometer (time, steps, distance, calories)

Multiple Sports Modes: Walking, Running, Climbing, Cycling, Indoor Running

3. Health Monitoring

Heart Rate Monitoring

Blood Pressure Tracking

Blood Oxygen (SpO₂) Measurement

Sleep Monitoring

Sedentary Reminder

Drinking Water Reminder

Breathing Exercises

4. Smart Notifications

Caller ID & Call Alerts

Message & App Notifications: SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, Skype, Line, WeChat, QQ

5. Additional Functions

Raise Wrist to Wake Screen

Low Power Mode & Silent Mode

Anti-Lost Alert

Remote Camera Control

Music Playback Control

Stopwatch & Alarm Clock

Calendar

Built-in Calculator
